name: arbitrage
title_zh: 动手前先算清这段活该谁干
tagline_zh: Claude 会话里一进入实现规划就自动接管：把每块活拆开，判断该留在本地、丢给子代理还是走别的执行面。
tagline_en: Auto-engages the moment implementation planning starts in a Claude session, splitting work and routing each piece.
desc_en: Always active when coding in a Claude (Fable) session. Triggers whenever implementation work is being planned, scoped, or about to start — before writing any code — to decide where each piece of work executes.
why_zh: 它卡在写代码之前那一步，而不是事后补救。路由决策被前置成规划的一部分，而不是靠你临时拍脑袋。
why_en: It sits before the first line of code, not after. Routing becomes part of planning instead of an improvised call you make.
limit_zh: 只在 Claude（Fable）会话里生效，别的编辑器或纯 API 调用不触发；它只做「在哪执行」的分配决策。
limit_en: Only fires inside a Claude (Fable) session — other editors or raw API calls won't trigger it. It only decides where work runs: no code, no tests, no.
title_en: Decide who runs each task before you code
